items.title: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支

sources.title: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支
sources.title_zh: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支
sources.title_original: 我如何对抗AI脑力透支
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把 Claude Code 和 Codex 的多线程任务放进 git 里的 markdown 工单队列，用 owner inbox 汇总需人判断项，并坚持一次只处理一项、处理完即关闭上下文，以对抗在 20 个线程间切换造成的脑力透支。

en.title: How I fight AI mental exhaustion
en.reason: By putting Claude Code and Codex tasks into a git-based markdown ticket queue and an owner inbox for human-judgment items, the author handles one ticket at a time and closes context after finishing, countering switching across 20 threads.

sources.title: 用Claude Code和Codex多线程时如何应对AI脑力过载

sources.title_en: How I Fight AI Brain Fry
sources.title_original: How I Fight AI Brain Fry
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者把Claude Code/Codex的20线程收进git markdown工单队列，由agent循环处理，待判断项进owner inbox，只关闭一个上下文。

en.reason: Funnelling 20 parallel Claude Code and Codex threads into a git markdown ticket queue worked by an agent loop, with judgment calls routed to an owner inbox, leaves only one context to close.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇讨论如何应对 AI Brain Fry：评论者用多个 agent threads 绑项目，以轻 token 的 skill 借 eleventy 渲染 markdown，配合自建 thisbit.ai 评论或配音，并称 Gemini (Argon 4) 的 TUI 渲染胜过 codex 与 Claude code。

en.reason: A commenter binds multiple agent threads to projects, renders markdown through eleventy with a lightweight-token skill, and runs thisbit.ai for comments or voiceover, arguing Gemini (Argon 4)'s TUI rendering beats codex and Claude Code.
